headline: Biggest swell of the week but 20mph onshore has it wrecked.
today: Prime SSE angle and 7ft faces at 7s is exactly the day you'd want — except 19-21mph S onshore has it maxed and messy. Afternoon and evening stay cross-on at 15-18mph so there's no clean window. Frustrating, but sit today out and be ready for tomorrow.

daysToWatch.note: This is the one to rearrange plans for — 3.1-4.7ft holding at 6s on a good angle with light NW winds dawn through morning. Glassy and shoulder-high, bring the shortboard and get there early.
Smaller at 2.2-2.7ft but prime angle and cross-off NNE/WNW in the morning keeps it clean. Worth a look on a groveler before the SW cross-on comes up.
